notes:
To test the app:
1. Log in with the demo credentials above (use Email login, not Google/Apple)
2. The app generates AI-powered cover letters for job applications
3. Upload a resume PDF from the profile section
4. Enter a company name and job description to generate a cover letter
5. Review the generated cover letter and send the application via email

The app requires an internet connection to function. All AI generation happens server-side.
